name: Algorithmic Constraint Obfuscation
description: Replaced the simple algebraic formula with a short, non-linear recurrence sequence modulo 7. The sequence is designed to evaluate to 0 only when the two inputs are different (1 and 2), and to positive values otherwise. Since the target sum across all edges is 0 and all terms are non-negative, this forces every edge to connect different grades. This defeats models that rely on recognizing polynomial forms of graph cuts, forcing them to accurately trace the sequence's execution to deduce the bipartite structure.
